_comment: The declared label set for this repository: one source, so CONTRIBUTING.md and the issue
templates cannot cite a label that does not exist. `kind`: type (exactly one per issue),
modifier (optional), area (zero or more), priority (at most one), github-default (created by
GitHub or Dependabot, kept so this is a complete inventory). Colours are hex without '#'.
.github/workflows/labels.yml checks this file against the labels GitHub actually holds.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Improvements or additions to documentation

labels.name: performance
labels.description: Latency, recall quality or resource use

labels.name: security
labels.description: Hardening or a vulnerability; suspected leaks go through SECURITY.md

labels.name: cleanup
labels.description: Removing dead weight from the repo

labels.name: research
labels.description: Exploration with a written conclusion

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

labels.name: needs-decision
labels.description: Waits on an owner decision (design choice or protected area)

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Cannot move until something external happens; the issue says what

labels.name: needs-bench
labels.description: Touches recall ranking or embeddings: run mismem-bench before and after

labels.name: breaking
labels.description: Changes a CLI flag, env var, MCP tool contract or HTTP response

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server, the six tools and the engram-compat aliases

labels.name: area:search
labels.description: Lexical and semantic recall, ranking and embeddings

labels.name: area:consolidation
labels.description: LLM consolidation, Pareto prefilter and forget

labels.name: area:http
labels.description: HTTP server, auth, Host guard and request limits

labels.name: area:viewer
labels.description: Viewer API and the React interface

labels.name: area:ingest
labels.description: Importers: ChatGPT, VS Code, file walks, Engram migration

labels.name: area:cli
labels.description: Command-line tools and their argument parsing

labels.name: area:hooks
labels.description: Client hooks: inject and used

labels.name: area:deploy
labels.description: Docker image, install.sh and deployment

labels.name: area:ci
labels.description: Workflows, tooling and repository configuration

labels.name: priority:high
labels.description: Do before anything else: data loss, wrong recall or a broken release

labels.name: priority:medium
labels.description: Planned work with no deadline pressure

labels.name: priority:low
labels.description: Worth doing when adjacent work is open

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Good for newcomers

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Extra attention is needed

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: This doesn't seem right

labels.name: question
labels.description: Further information is requested

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: docker
labels.description: Pull requests that update docker code

labels.name: github_actions
labels.description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code

labels.name: javascript
labels.description: Pull requests that update javascript code
